audit-4.3-1.title: Posting by path refuses files main could read: another session's, task attachments, hard links, over 20 MiB, dot-dot, odd names, state and files roots

audit-4.3-2.title: Symlinked tools manifests, persona and owner files are rejected, so tools, hooks, personas and reviews vanish

audit-4.3-3.title: Repo tools gained a five-minute kill, 64 KiB output, argument and manifest limits, and changed exit codes and errors

audit-4.3-7.title: Owner, persona and hook reads gained 256 KiB, 1024-entry and 4 MiB caps

archive-force-keeps-worktree.title: Forced archive leaves the worktree and branch on disk, also past the cleanup retry, when it holds a nested repository or over 16 MiB untracked

worktree-status-unavailable.title: Worktree status is 503 "on the owning runner" for a missing worktree, a nested repository or over 16 MiB untracked

worktree-status-format.title: Uncommitted files lose their git status prefix in worktree status

archive-shared-worktree.title: Archiving an owner keeps a worktree another agent works in until that agent is archived

archive-switched-branch.title: Archive no longer deletes the branch a worktree was switched to

worktree-status-fields.title: Worktree status gained ownership, owner, borrowers and checkoutState

stop-hook-kills-children.title: A stop hook that times out has its whole process group killed, including what it left running

owner-review-fingerprint.title: Owner reviews fail with over 10,000 dirty files, over 16 MiB untracked, or a nested repository

owner-review-briefing.title: Owner reviews add reviewedState and a new preamble in every reviewer briefing

persona-catalog-caps.title: The persona catalog stops at 100 files or 4 MiB

persona-catalog-warning.title: An oversized default-branch persona is reported as an incomplete listing, without naming the file

worktree-launch-failure.title: A child whose worktree cannot be created ends stopped, not error and blocked, with a different message

worktree-outside-git-base.title: A worktree request outside Git records no base branch, where main records main

changes-path-rules.title: A changed file with a backslash in its name cannot be opened in Changes

changes-unchanged-file.title: The file diff of an unchanged file is 404, where main returns it as added

changes-image-response.title: Diff images are no longer cached for 30 seconds and carry a revision

files-error-text.title: Files refuses bad paths with different text

icon-no-content.title: A missing repository or project icon is 204, not 404

tool-descriptions.title: launch_agent and set_workspace describe runners to every local agent

agent-record-field.title: Every local agent record gained runnerManaged

schema-version.title: The signed readiness answer reports the branch's 11 extra migrations. Needs an owner decision to become intended
